title: Reverse
prompt: The robot reads its log back to front: the same items, last one first, in a new array. [1, 2, 3] becomes [3, 2, 1].
hints: Loop over the items and put each at the front of a new array with push_front, or use the reverse() method.

docs.name: for item in list:
docs.what: Runs the indented lines once per item, with item holding each value in turn.

docs.name: list.push_front(value)
docs.what: Adds value at the start. Returns nothing.

docs.name: list.reverse()
docs.what: Reverses the array in place. Returns nothing.
